name: DeepSeek
summary: DeepSeek chat and reasoning models through an OpenAI-compatible API, plus web Search and Fetch tools.
notes: Model names: deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro; deepseek-v4-flash still works but is served by the Flash model.
Thinking (reasoning) is on by default; send thinking {"type":"disabled"} for a plain reply.
Search and Fetch cost $0.75 per 1,000 successful calls; empty results, failures and timeouts are free. Rate limits are per account: Search 100 QPS, Fetch 25 QPS plus a per-domain limit.

endpoints.name: Create a chat completion
endpoints.summary: Send a conversation to a DeepSeek model and get the reply.

messages.description: Conversation as {role, content} messages; roles system, user, assistant, tool.

thinking.description: {"type":"enabled"} or {"type":"disabled"}; enabled when omitted. Wins over reasoning_effort.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens in the reply, 1 to 393216.

temperature.description: 0 to 2, default 1; no effect in thinking mode.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling, above 0 and at most 1.

response_format.description: {"type":"json_object"} for JSON mode (the prompt must also ask for JSON).

tool_choice.description: none, auto, required or a named function; required and named choices fail in thinking mode.

notes: Do not set stream: true; this client returns one JSON body.
In thinking mode the reasoning is in choices[].message.reasoning_content, the answer in content.
Billed per token; see the pricing page.

endpoints.name: List models
endpoints.summary: The models the key can call, with context window and output limit.

endpoints.name: Get account balance
endpoints.summary: Whether the balance covers calls, and granted and topped-up balances by currency.

endpoints.name: Search the web
endpoints.summary: Ranked web results with snippets, model-ready summaries and optionally page content.

query.description: Search query, 1 to 128 characters; supports site:, -site: and quoted phrases.

count.description: Results to return, 1 to 50; default 10. Does not change the price.

ori_question.description: The user's original question, 1 to 128 characters, to improve query understanding.

localization.description: An IP address to localize results to.

need_content.description: Return page content in content; default false (content is then empty).

notes: rerank_score runs 0 to 3 (1.5 and up is high quality); authority runs -1 (unknown) to 4.

endpoints.name: Fetch a page as Markdown
endpoints.summary: Fetch one URL and return its title and content as Markdown.

url.description: http(s) URL, up to 8192 characters, without a username or password.

notes: 403 means blocked by DeepSeek's security policy; 404 means no usable content could be retrieved (not billed).
